product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow helps mid-market businesses collect customer feedback across channels, analyze it with AI, and take action to improve customer experience.

employee_band.notes: Publicly listed company-size band, not an exact headcount.

eng_blog.notes: Its developer publication includes Mohamed Nainar’s account of implementing SLOs and Ganapathi Subramanian’s account of upgrading its PostgreSQL infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple guide collections and detailed integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed openings contain no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title; Revenue Operations Analyst and Solution Engineer roles do not qualify.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Anthropic Claude Sonnet through Amazon Bedrock.
model_provider.notes: OpenAI and Azure OpenAI are disclosed for generative AI features; the AWS case study identifies Claude Sonnet for summarization, clustering, and sentiment scoring.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center names all four. HIPAA support requires a paid add-on and signed Business Associate Agreement.

last_funding.notes: Latest publicly listed round in the funding profile, updated November 4, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed funding round is April 2019, before the requested window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Business Development Representative - US posting with an application option.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced SparrowCRM on September 3, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small public executive listing shows founder/CEO Shihab Muhammed, CEO since 2017, and a business-unit head. No qualifying publicly announced hire or departure was found; coverage relies on third-party listings.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are documented native-integration signals, not confirmation that SurveySparrow uses all three internally.
